name: hotkernel
description: Nsight, SASS and a verify-and-record contract for the GPU on your desk: ten MCP tools plus the kernel-speedrun loop that profiles a kernel, rewrites it in Triton, verifies it against the baseline n times and records the verdict.

hotkernel_python.title: Python with your PyTorch
hotkernel_python.description: Path to the interpreter that has your PyTorch and Triton, e.g. ~/venvs/mytorch/bin/python. bench, verify, torch_trace and profile run targets with it. Leave empty to let hotkernel use the first python/python3 on PATH that can import torch.
